steps.name: State Bank of India
steps.channel: Branch Manager, State Bank of India
steps.when_to_use: For reporting fraudulent electronic banking transactions and applying for compensation.
steps.source: RBI (Commercial Banks - Responsible Business Conduct) Third Amendment Directions, 2026, Para 4 (contd.)

steps.name: CPGRAMS
steps.channel: Central Public Grievance Redress And Monitoring System portal
steps.when_to_use: For public grievances against central government bodies like SBI after approaching the bank.
steps.source: RBI (Commercial Banks - Responsible Business Conduct) Third Amendment Directions, 2026, Para 4 (contd.)

note: Ensure you provide the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal acknowledgement number when filing your complaint with the bank.
sources: RBI (Commercial Banks - Responsible Business Conduct) Third Amendment Directions, 2026, Para 4 (contd.)
